item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q009_heme_bundle_fold_not_homology","answer":"No. In SCOPe 2.08, these proteins are in the same membrane-protein fold but not in one homologous superfamily: fold f.21 is \"Heme-binding four-helical bundle\" under class f, \"Membrane and cell surface proteins and peptides\"; its sibling superfamilies include f.21.1, \"Transmembrane di-heme cytochromes\", f.21.2, \"Fumarate reductase respiratory complex transmembrane subunits\", and f.21.3, \"Respiratory nitrate reductase 1 gamma chain\". The shared f.21 fold records a common four-transmembrane-helix heme-binding architecture, while the split into f.21.1/f.21.2/f.21.3 says SCOPe does not make the stronger superfamily-level homology assertion across those named groups. A concrete SCOPe comparison of d1qlac_, Wolinella succinogenes fumarate reductase FrdC in f.21.2.1, with d1q16c_, Escherichia coli respiratory nitrate reductase gamma chain in f.21.3.1, has lowest shared node f.21 and relationship \"same_fold\", so that pair should be treated as structurally analogous at the fold level rather than as SCOPe-supported homologs. Consequently, fold membership alone is not safe evidence for transferring family-specific respiratory-complex function, heme/quinone-chain annotations, or homologous-template status between transmembrane di-heme cytochromes, fumarate-reductase membrane subunits, and nitrate-reductase gamma chains; representative selection should keep the three superfamilies separate unless independent sequence/structure evidence demonstrates a closer relationship.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope.get_scop_service_info: /api/v1/; /api/v1/releases/current","mcp__scope.resolve_scop_identifier: /api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/f.21","mcp__scope.resolve_scop_identifier: /api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/f.21.1","mcp__scope.resolve_scop_identifier: /api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/f.21.2","mcp__scope.resolve_scop_identifier: /api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/f.21.3","mcp__scope.get_scop_pdb_entry: /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1qla; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1qla/domains; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1qla/chains","mcp__scope.get_scop_pdb_entry: /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1q16; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1q16/domains; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1q16/chains","mcp__scope.compare_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1qlac_; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1qlac_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1qlac_/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1qlac_/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1q16c_; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1q16c_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1q16c_/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1q16c_/homology"]}]}
